title: Opportunity
description: Cross-source pain opportunity row for Pulse. opportunity_id MUST be stable across days: hash of product_key|normalized_pain (never daily-random). Optional additive fields: lane, url. CSV path: data/opportunities/YYYY-MM-DD.csv (+ jsonl OK). Headers (exact): opportunity_id,ts,run_id,product_key,brand,pain,evidence_count,sources_json,confidence,suggested_next,alert_user,summary — plus optional lane,url.

opportunity_id.description: Stable key across days: hash of product_key|normalized_pain (e.g. opp-{sha256-8}). Not daily-random.

sources_json.description: JSON array of source names as a string, or blank

url.description: Optional additive column — representative evidence URL
